[3] customer-service-playbook.md > Channels and hours
## Channels and hours

Support comes in by phone at (301) 555-0147, by email to help@lanternsupply.example, and by chat
on the online store. All three are handled from the Frederick office. Our hours are Monday through
Friday, 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern, and Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern. We are closed on
Sundays and on the six company holidays.

Every email is answered within 1 business day; aim for the same day. Phone callers wait less than
3 minutes; when the queue passes 3 minutes the shift lead takes calls too. Chat is answered within
3 minutes during support hours. Outside hours, chat shows a form that becomes an email.

All three channels log in Gorgias, our help desk. One customer, one conversation: if someone
emails and then calls, merge the tickets so the next person sees the whole story.

[4] showrooms.md > Contact
## Contact

Both showrooms are reached through the main number, (301) 555-0147: option 3 for Frederick, option
4 for Annapolis. Email help@lanternsupply.example reaches customer support, which can pass a
message to either showroom the same day.

[5] about.md > The story
For the first ten years the business was lamps, wicks, fuel and repairs. In 2003 the company
assembled its first Hagerstown Kerosene Lantern in a rented bay in Hagerstown, and in 2009 it
sold its first LED lantern, the Firefly 100. The online store opened in 2011. The Annapolis
showroom opened in May 2014, and in 2016 the warehouse and Repair Center moved into the current
building at 1180 Downsville Pike in Hagerstown, with the loading dock at Dock B that every return
and repair comes through.

Priya Whitcomb-Nair, Marjorie and Dale's daughter, joined the company in 2010 to run the online
store and became CEO in 2019. Marjorie and Dale retired the same year and still visit the
Frederick showroom most Saturdays. The company remains privately held and family owned.
